title: family_get_requests
description: Open requests of the children in scope plus answered/expired ones of the last 24 hours. Family manager devices (effective rule family_manager) and babysitter devices with access (only the open requests, include_closed is ignored); otherwise family_error {not_permitted}. Also accepted through the integration relay (POST /api/integration/family) when the device is away. Answer: family_requests.

request_id.description: Optional id of the app, echoed in the answer.
